installPolicy: Fresh user-owned directory under ~/.local/share/tiye-feasibility; no profile, PATH, existing installation, credential or auth changes
archivePolicy: Require pinned digest; reject links, special files, absolute paths, dot-dot paths and oversized contents; extract regular files/directories only
authPolicy: Version/help only with isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME and allowlisted environment; no login, auth status, app-server session or inference
scope: Linux CLI availability prerequisite only; not S4 eligibility or S6 CLI parity
